title: The AI Bubble Is About to POP… Here's the Warning Sign Nobody Sees
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: AI follows the four-step tech-bubble pattern (borrowed build-out, product price collapse, costly money, levered players break); three steps are already underway.
Data center loans are hard to syndicate, private credit inflows dried up, CoreWeave and Oracle credit stress rising.
Rental prices still rising (H100 ~$3.81/hr); a sustained rollover would be the trigger for the bust, so no immediate pop.

calls.condition: Bust begins once weekly GPU rental rates fall for a couple of months or a hyperscaler cuts capex plans
calls.reason: Hyperscaler capex outruns cloud revenue and is increasingly debt-financed; history says AI stocks will crash like railroads/telecom, but GPU rents are still rising so not yet.
calls.quote: Three of the four steps are already here. The fourth is a number you can check every week

notes: No date in transcript (references prices 'as of October 19th' and upcoming Oct 28-29 earnings). Ticker is a proxy for 'AI stocks'; he explicitly says he doesn't expect an immediate pop. Promises buy list in a follow-up video.
